headline: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - EMKAY: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved an investment in the Equity Shares of Emkay Capital Private Limited (ECPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, of amount not…
detail: Acquisition - EMKAY: Emkay Global Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board has approved an investment in the Equity Shares of Emkay Capital Private Limited (ECPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, of amount not exceeding Rs. 30 Crores by way of subscription to Rights Issue of Equity Shares of ECPL having face value of Rs. 10 each, at par, in one or more tranches.
